title: cytisus scoparius var. pallescens
intro: Cytisus scoparius var. pallescens, commonly known as pale broom or pale Scotch broom, is a variety of flowering plant in the legume family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include aiding in the treatment of various health issues such as anxiety, insomnia, and digestive problems due to its health benefits of being a mild sedative and anti-inflammatory agent. The therapeutic actions of pale Scotch broom include sedation, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, which are attributed to its ability to relax muscles and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Cytisus scoparius var. pallescens include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions and are found in its leaves, flowers, and stems.
